verdict.root_cause: The seat is shown as something that can be selected, but it cannot receive keyboard focus. As a result, pressing keyboard keys does not select it or enable booking.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the required keyboard-only method, first using Tab and then attempting to select 14C with keyboard input. It did not use a mouse or take an unrelated action. The failure was caused by the page not making the required seat reachable by keyboard, not by an agent mistake.
verdict.bug_title: Seat 14C cannot be selected with keyboard navigation

signals.excerpt: Seat 14C is a non-focusable DIV (tabIndex -1), so keyboard-only navigation cannot select it.

verdict.suggestion: Make each selectable seat a native button or otherwise keyboard-focusable control, and support Enter and Space to select it. Verify that Tab can reach 14C and that booking then displays “Booked 14C”.
verdict.one_liner: Seat 14C cannot be chosen by a keyboard-only user, so the booking cannot be completed.
